competency.title: Compare exploration — human review
competency.outcome: Compare two plausible methods for exploration using an exploration-policy comparison. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

topic_kernel.measure: coverage and regret under fixed steps

competency.practice_task: Produce a paired comparison and tradeoff table grounded in an exploration-policy comparison.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.
required_evidence: a paired comparison and tradeoff table
Include reviewer notes, disagreement resolution and audit trail.
Report coverage and regret under fixed steps with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: rewarding novelty without task progress.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of exploration.
Practice: same inputs and budgets yield a justified choice.
Measurement: report coverage and regret under fixed steps against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for rewarding novelty without task progress; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
